title: Closure under answer predicates
statement: A verifier model $E$ is closed under answer predicates if, for every verifier $M$ and Boolean value $b$, whenever $M$ is efficient in $E$, the Boolean verifier that accepts exactly when $M$ returns the answer $b$ is also efficient in $E$.
